AWAY_WIN.definition: Away team ahead at the final state, nearest the away-win conditional medians.

EXTRA_INNINGS.definition: Tied after regulation; representative among extra-inning games.

HIGH_SCORING.definition: Nearest the conditional 90th percentile of total runs, not the maximum.

HOME_WIN.definition: Home team ahead at the final state, nearest the home-win conditional medians.

LOW_SCORING.definition: Nearest the conditional 10th percentile of total runs, not necessarily 0-0.

TYPICAL.definition: Minimum absolute distance to the population expected total runs and expected run differential.
